FN-CXGLXJQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 144
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 144 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of
State's Office to maintain a record of liens on aircrafts, which could be offset, in whole or in
part, by the collection of filing fees, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
